description: Source code for a ZIP extraction utility using yauzl, implementing an Extractor class with methods to extract ZIP entries, handle symlinks, directories, and manage extraction modes. Exports an async function to initialize extraction with given path and options.

classes.name: Extractor
classes.description: Class responsible for extracting ZIP files, handling entries, directories, symlinks, and modes.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Asynchronously opens the ZIP file and processes each entry, handling errors and completion.

methods.name: extractEntry
methods.description: Extracts individual ZIP entry, creating directories, handling symlinks, and writing files.

methods.name: getExtractedMode
methods.description: Determines the file mode for extracted entries, applying defaults if necessary.
